# CANDIDATE: GAP_GO_VIX_FILTER_RIBBON_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

A gap-up that holds above the opening range high, accompanied by elevated VIX (>20) and a short-term bullish EMA8>EMA21 ribbon, captures continuation momentum. The edge exists because gaps that survive initial profit-taking and show institutional participation (volume > average) tend to extend, especially when volatility is elevated and short-term momentum is aligned.

## Mechanism

Entry: When the open gaps up >0.5% from prior close, price holds above the opening range high (ORH) for the first 15 minutes, VIX > 20, EMA8 > EMA21, and volume > average volume (20-bar), enter long at the close of the 15-minute bar. Exit: Stop at the opening range low (ORL); target at 1.5× the gap size; if price extends, trail with a 10% price-based trailing stop after 1× risk is achieved. (Regime hint: best in VIX 20‑30; avoid low‑VIX <12.)
